answer: Measure trust as the max-flow from the honest seed wharf to each identity, every edge carrying bounded capacity. Honest nodes sit in a basin flow reaches by many independent channels. A sybil region, however many personas it spins up and however densely they vouch internally, reaches the honest world only through a few bridge edges — so the TOTAL flow into the whole farm is capped by that thin cut, never by headcount. One lantern's worth of capacity split across a thousand fakes leaves each a vanishing ripple; internal mutual vouches add nothing across the cut.
